newsitem.title: UK: Granada could selling more Forte hotels.
newsitem.headline: Granada could selling more Forte hotels.

text.p: UK media and leisure group Granada said on Wednesday that it was considering selling more of the hotels it acquired in its takeover of Forte this year.
"There are a number of hotels that are not consistent with their brands and don't come up to standards in certain ways," a company spokeswoman said.

Property agent Christie & Co had been asked to put a valuation on the group of 22 properties, she said, but denied a newspaper report this week that it had already been instructed to sell them. Most of the hotels are mid-market Forte Heritage or Posthouse properties.
A report in the Guardian newspaper this week put a price tag of around 50 million stg on the properties.
Granada, which completed a 3.9 billion stg takeover of hotel and catering company Forte in January, has announced plans to sell 17 luxury hotels grouped in the Exclusive portfolio.
Granada is aiming to raise well in excess of one billion stg from the sale.
